categories.name: SPL22
categories.content: SPL22 is a hybrid token extension of the Solana blockchain that combines the features of both fungible and non-fungible tokens.

categories.name: Wrapped-Tokens
categories.content: Wrapped tokens offer a way to circumvent the lack of interoperability between different blockchains. The wrapping of a token happens when the original asset is put into a “wrapper” and deployed on a different blockchain. With it being wrapped, the cryptocurrency can now be used on a blockchain where it previously wasn’t available. One example of a wrapped token would be Wrapped Bitcoin (WBTC). It is an ERC-20 version of Bitcoin, which allows it to be used on protocols based on Ethereum. Watch this video to learn more about Wrapped tokens.

categories.name: Farming-as-a-Service (FaaS)
categories.content: Farming-as-a Service simplifies the process of yield farming by handling the technical aspects, such as choosing the right liquidity pools, managing the staking or lending process, and optimizing the yield.

categories.name: Kumbaya Launchpad
categories.content: Kumbaya is a community-first DEX and launchpad designed as a high-performance hub for 'cult' tokens and cultural assets.

categories.name: topblast.lol Ecosystem
categories.content: topblast.lol is a launchpad on The Open Network (TON), integrating fair-launch mechanics with a comprehensive Telegram-native DeFi ecosystem.

categories.name: Tokenized Pre-IPO Stocks
categories.content: Tokenized Pre-IPO Stocks are on-chain proxy instruments that offer fractional exposure to private companies, allowing users to trade the value of high-growth startups before they reach public stock exchanges.

categories.name: Long Launchpad
categories.content: Tokens launched through LONG (https://x.com/longdotxyz), a token launchpad on Robinhood Chain whose defining feature is that every launch trades against a Robinhood Stock Token.

categories.name: Pump Fund Portfolio
categories.content: Projects and tokens officially backed by Pump Fund, the venture arm of Pump.fun. These projects are selected for their adherence to "build in public" principles, transparent development, and verified founder commitment.

categories.name: Bankr Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokens deployed through Bankr (https://bankr.bot/) via the Bankr Terminal, Bankr agent/API/CLI, or a @bankrbot social command.

categories.name: Yield Farming
categories.content: Yield farming involves putting cryptocurrency into a DeFi protocol to collect interest on trading fees. Liquidity providers can profit by providing liquidity in DeFi protocols like Uniswap, utilizing assets that would otherwise sit idle on an exchange or hot wallet.

categories.name: Synthetic
categories.content: This category includes both synthetic asset issuers and the synthetic assets themselves. Synthetic assets are on-chain tokens that replicate the price behavior of another asset, whether it’s a fiat currency, commodity, or stock using smart contracts and price oracles.

categories.name: MXN Stablecoin
categories.content: Stablecoins that maintain a stable value by reference to the Mexican peso (MXN).

categories.name: Binance Alpha Spotlight
categories.content: Binance Alpha is a platform within Binance Wallet that highlights promising early-stage crypto projects before they potentially list on Binance.

categories.name: Four.Meme Tokenized Stocks (4Stock)
categories.content: Tokens issued by Four.Meme under its 4Stock product. Each 4Stock is intended to be backed by its corresponding underlying share, purchased and held by Four.Meme through a dedicated managed account.

categories.name: AUD Stablecoin
categories.content: A AUD stablecoin is a type of cryptocurrency that is designed to maintain a stable value by being pegged to the Australian Dollar (AUD).

categories.name: Pools Launchpad
categories.content: Tokens launched through Pools (https://pools.trade/), Uniswap's first-party token issuance platform.
